# Ordering a replacement card

> **INFORMATION** Only for active accounts.

Use [Card Services] to order.

1. Check the address.
   * Ask for the postcode.
2. Order the card.

## Fees

| Card | Fee |
| --- | --- |
| Debit | * Free * Next day: 5 pounds |

> **WARNING** Never ask for the PIN.
>
> Report it if offered.
